title: Join the pool
intro: Share this computer with the pool. While you are in, it does AI work for everyone in the pool.
needs-ollama: This app needs Ollama, a free program that runs the models.
for-gemma4-26b: Chat. The largest model here, slower.
for-clef-flash: Decisions: short typed answers, such as yes or no.
for-upscale-quality: Makes pictures four times larger, with more detail, slower.
cooling: Cooling down ({c} °C): no work for a moment
privacy: It connects only to pool.visualia.space. Only the model, time and energy of the work are recorded, never what was asked or answered.
update-ready: Version {version} is ready. Updating leaves the pool and restarts the app.
version-off: Version {version}. Updates are turned off on this computer.
